recipe.title: Rajma Recipe (Rajma Masala)

ingredients.name: 1 cup rajma ((200 grams dry kidney beans or 2 – 15 Oz canned beans (3 cups)))
1 cup (120 grams) fine chopped onions ( (or ¾ cup grated or cube, boil & puree))
1 green chilli (( chopped or slit, optional))
1½ teaspoon ginger garlic paste ((or 1 teaspoon each minced & crushed))
1½ cups (2 large, 300 grams) tomatoes ((chopped & pureed, or 1 cup canned tomato puree))
½ to 1 teaspoon red chilli powder ((Kashmiri or byadgi))
¾ teaspoon garam masala ( (¼ to ½ teaspoon for later))
½ teaspoon salt ((½ teaspoon more to adjust))
½ to 1 tablespoon kasuri methi ((dried fenugreek leaves))

steps.text: Add rajma to a large bowl and rinse them thrice. Soak them uncovered in 4 cups water for at least 6 hours to overnight. Discard the water and rinse them well.
steps.label: Soak rajma
steps.attention_cue: Soak them uncovered in 4 cups water for at least 6 hours to overnight.
consumes_ingredients: 1 cup rajma ((200 grams dry kidney beans or 2 – 15 Oz canned beans (3 cups)))

steps.text: Transfer them to a stovetop pressure cooker or instant pot.  Pour 1½ cups water and pressure cook until soft, for 4 to 5 whistles. Or in the instant pot for 12 to 16 mins, depending on the age of rajma.
steps.label: Cook rajma
steps.attention_cue: pressure cook until soft, for 4 to 5 whistles. Or in the instant pot for 12 to 16 mins
steps.doneness_cue: soft enough yet hold there shape

steps.text: Once cooked they should be soft enough yet hold there shape. If you mash a rajma with your fingers it should get mashed easily.
steps.label: Check doneness
steps.doneness_cue: soft enough yet hold there shape

steps.text: Heat ghee or oil in a pot. Add cumin seeds and bay leaf. When they begin to sizzle add the onions and green chili.
steps.label: Start tadka
consumes_ingredients: 1 cup (120 grams) fine chopped onions ( (or ¾ cup grated or cube, boil & puree))
1 green chilli (( chopped or slit, optional))

steps.text: Saute on a medium heat until golden. Stir in the ginger garlic and saute for a minute, until aromatic.
steps.label: Sauté onions
consumes_ingredients: 1½ teaspoon ginger garlic paste ((or 1 teaspoon each minced & crushed))

steps.text: Pour the tomato puree & cook until the onion tomato mixture turns thick, for about 3 min.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes
consumes_ingredients: 1½ cups (2 large, 300 grams) tomatoes ((chopped & pureed, or 1 cup canned tomato puree))

steps.text: Stir in the spices – red chili powder, garam masala, coriander powder, cumin powder and turmeric. Saute for 2 to 3 minutes, until the masala begins to smell aromatic.
steps.label: Add spices
consumes_ingredients: ½ to 1 teaspoon red chilli powder ((Kashmiri or byadgi))
¾ teaspoon garam masala ( (¼ to ½ teaspoon for later))
steps.doneness_cue: until the masala begins to smell aromatic

steps.text: Add the rajma along with the stock (rajma cooked water). Pour more hot water as required (about ½ to 1 cup, only as required) to make a gravy. (If using canned beans, drain the liquid from the can and rinse them before adding).
steps.label: Combine rajma

steps.text: Mix well and simmer for 10 to 15 mins, until slightly thick. To make the gravy thick, if you want mash a tbsp of the rajma and add back.
steps.label: Simmer gravy

steps.text: Taste test and add more salt, ¼ teaspoon garam masala if required and crushed kasuri methi. Optionally you may stir in cream and garnish with coriander leaves and ginger juliennes. You can also make a dhaba style tadka garnish or a restaurant style creamy finish from the post.
steps.label: Finish & season
consumes_ingredients: ¾ teaspoon garam masala ( (¼ to ½ teaspoon for later))
½ to 1 tablespoon kasuri methi ((dried fenugreek leaves))

steps.text: Squeeze some lemon juice before serving. Serve rajma with chawal (rice).
steps.label: Serve

steps.text: Press Saute button and pour ghee to the steel insert. When the ghee melts, add cumin seeds, bay leaf, chopped onions, green chili and salt.
steps.label: IP sauté start
consumes_ingredients: 1 cup (120 grams) fine chopped onions ( (or ¾ cup grated or cube, boil & puree))
1 green chilli (( chopped or slit, optional))
½ teaspoon salt ((½ teaspoon more to adjust))

steps.text: Saute for about 5 minutes stirring constantly to cook evenly until golden, about to caramelize but not burnt.
steps.label: Sauté onions (IP)
steps.doneness_cue: until golden, about to caramelize but not burnt

steps.text: Add ginger garlic & saute for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
steps.label: Add ginger-garlic (IP)
consumes_ingredients: 1½ teaspoon ginger garlic paste ((or 1 teaspoon each minced & crushed))

steps.text: Add all the spice powders – chili powder, garam masala, turmeric, coriander powder and cumin powder.
steps.label: Add spices (IP)
consumes_ingredients: ½ to 1 teaspoon red chilli powder ((Kashmiri or byadgi))
¾ teaspoon garam masala ( (¼ to ½ teaspoon for later))

steps.text: Press cancel. Add overnight soaked rajma and pour 2 cups water. Deglaze to release any bits of food stuck at the bottom.
steps.label: Add rajma (IP)

steps.text: Place a trivet and keep the bowl of tomato puree over that. Secure the IP with the lid and pressure cook for 18 mins (for softer beans, if you prefer al dente – 16 mins).
steps.label: Pressure cook (IP)
steps.attention_cue: pressure cook for 18 mins (for softer beans, if you prefer al dente – 16 mins)
consumes_ingredients: 1½ cups (2 large, 300 grams) tomatoes ((chopped & pureed, or 1 cup canned tomato puree))

steps.text: When the pressure drops, open the IP. Rajma should super soft, yet hold shape. Pour the tomato puree and cook for 2 to 3 mins on saute mode. For a thicker consistency, mash some of the rajma. (If required pour about ½ to ¾ cup water to bring to a runny consistency.)
steps.label: Finish in IP
consumes_ingredients: 1½ cups (2 large, 300 grams) tomatoes ((chopped & pureed, or 1 cup canned tomato puree))

steps.text: Taste test and add more salt, ¼ teaspoon garam masala, cream (optional) and crushed kasuri methi. Press cancel.
steps.label: Season (IP)
consumes_ingredients: ¾ teaspoon garam masala ( (¼ to ½ teaspoon for later))
½ to 1 tablespoon kasuri methi ((dried fenugreek leaves))

steps.text: Garnish with coriander leaves and ginger juliennes. Serve rajma with chawal. Drizzle some lemon juice.
steps.label: Garnish & serve (IP)
